scholarships.name: Kaplan Early Bird Scholarship
scholarships.description: Early-bird discount applied automatically when you pay the deposit at least 90 days before the start of your Kaplan pathway course (Foundation or Pre-Master's).
scholarships.descriptionRu: Автоматическая скидка при оплате депозита не менее чем за 90 дней до начала программы Kaplan (Foundation или Pre-Master's). Доступна на каждом из партнёрских университетов.

scholarships.name: Kaplan Academic Achievement Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based scholarship for top-performing applicants on Kaplan pathway programmes. Awarded after academic review of transcripts.
scholarships.descriptionRu: Стипендия за академические заслуги для лучших абитуриентов программ Kaplan. Присуждается после проверки академических документов.

accommodation.name: En-suite комната в студенческом общежитии (University of Twente)
accommodation.text: Одноместная комната с собственной ванной, общая кухня на 4–8 человек. Партнёрское жильё рядом с кампусом University of Twente.

paragraphs: The Netherlands is one of the world’s favourite international student destinations. The Netherlands offers a world-class education with an open-minded teaching style and an international focus. Students from over 160 countries have travelled to the Netherlands to earn their degrees.

The Netherlands is one of the safest and happiest countries in the world. It’s also centrally located and travelling to other cities and countries is as easy as boarding a train. Students who study in the Netherlands are at the centre of innovation, top-tier education opportunities, and hubs for international communities.
